name: itops-mcp-hub
description: Centralized IT Operations Hub with MCP gateway, Zabbix, MeshCentral, Express/Allinone/Odoo, ZKTime, pstack, and document RAG

scripts.build: npm run build -w @itops/mcp-common && npm run build -w @itops/mcp-zabbix && npm run build -w @itops/mcp-meshcentral && npm run build -w @itops/mcp-express && npm run build -w @itops/mcp-allinone && npm run build -w @itops/mcp-zktime && npm run build -w @itops/mcp-odoo && npm run build -w @itops/mcp-pstack && npm run build -w @itops/mcp-rag && npm run build -w @itops/mcp-host && npm run build -w @itops/mcp-hub && npm run build -w @itops/mcp-oauth
scripts.smoke: npm run smoke -w @itops/mcp-express && npm run smoke -w @itops/mcp-allinone && npm run smoke -w @itops/mcp-zktime && npm run smoke -w @itops/mcp-odoo && npm run smoke -w @itops/mcp-pstack && npm run smoke -w @itops/mcp-rag && npm run smoke -w @itops/mcp-host && npm run smoke -w @itops/mcp-oauth
